tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all Supabase projects for the authenticated user. Returns project IDs, names, regions, and status.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Supabase project by its reference ID. Returns name, region, status, and organization.

tools.name: get_project_health
tools.description: Get the health status of all services in a Supabase project (database, auth, realtime, storage, etc.).

tools.name: pause_project
tools.description: Pause a Supabase project. The project database and APIs will become unavailable. Use restore_project to bring it back.

tools.name: restore_project
tools.description: Restore a paused Supabase project. This will start the project database and APIs again.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List all organizations the authenticated user belongs to.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific organization by its slug.

tools.name: list_organization_members
tools.description: List all members of a Supabase organization, including their roles.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a SQL query against a Supabase project database. Returns the query results as rows. Use this for DDL (CREATE, ALTER, DROP), DML (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), and DQL (SELECT) operations.

tools.name: run_read_only_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query as the supabase_read_only_user role. Safer for SELECT queries — cannot modify data.

tools.name: generate_types
tools.description: Generate TypeScript type definitions from a Supabase project database schema. Returns the full TypeScript types for all tables, views, and functions.

tools.name: list_migrations
tools.description: List all applied database migrations for a Supabase project.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List all database backups for a Supabase project.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List all Edge Functions deployed to a Supabase project.

tools.name: get_function
tools.description: Get details of a specific Edge Function by its slug.

tools.name: delete_function
tools.description: Delete an Edge Function from a Supabase project.

tools.name: list_secrets
tools.description: List all secrets (environment variables) for a Supabase project. Secret values are masked in responses.

tools.name: create_secrets
tools.description: Create or update one or more secrets (environment variables) for a Supabase project. Existing secrets with the same name are overwritten.

tools.name: delete_secrets
tools.description: Delete one or more secrets (environment variables) from a Supabase project.

tools.name: get_api_keys
tools.description: Get the API keys for a Supabase project. Returns the anon key, service_role key, and any publishable/secret keys.

tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: List all storage buckets for a Supabase project.

tools.name: get_project_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent logs from a Supabase project. Supports filtering by log source (e.g., "postgres", "auth", "storage", "realtime", "edge-functions", "postgrest").

tools.name: get_performance_advisors
tools.description: Get performance advisor recommendations for a Supabase project. Identifies potential performance issues like missing indexes, unused indexes, and slow queries.

tools.name: get_security_advisors
tools.description: Get security advisor recommendations for a Supabase project. Identifies potential security issues like exposed credentials, weak RLS policies, and auth misconfigurations.

tools.name: get_postgrest_config
tools.description: Get the PostgREST (auto-generated REST API) configuration for a project. Includes default schema, max rows, and JWT secret role claim key.

tools.name: list_sql_snippets
tools.description: List saved SQL snippets for the authenticated user.
